Inside the model ↗

This page uses Jiayu Zhao’s exported word-score dictionaries. Text is lowercased and split on whitespace; punctuation is retained. Each known token adds its log score to both classes. If it appears in only one class, the other receives log(1 / (class total words + vocabulary size)). Tokens absent from both dictionaries are skipped. Repeated words are counted repeatedly. Both classes have equal priors.

Training selection: Q&A-stage statements from company speakers who also appeared in prepared remarks. This rule may retain closing remarks and miss executives who spoke only during Q&A. Predictions reflect language similarity, not verified sentence origin.
